popover.name: Popover
popover.purpose: Show a short anchored contextual panel with optional local actions without becoming a drawer, dialog, form system, or option-layer pattern.

anatomy.rule: Visible control that owns aria-expanded and opens the panel.
Anchored surface with short contextual content.
Keeps the panel visually connected to its trigger.
Uses concise text and optional local actions only.
Closes on Escape, outside interaction, or completed local action.

variants.description: Short explanation attached to a trigger.
Context for a compact metric or status.

popover.statePrecedence: disabled > warning > open > focus > hover > closed

Energy.decision: Use semantic action, surface, and state color.
Energy.behavior: The component communicates action and priority without raw colors.

Voice.decision: Use concise labels and short contextual copy.
Voice.behavior: Text explains the local decision without pattern instructions.

Frame.decision: Use stable geometry, spacing, and target size.

Depth.decision: Use elevation only when the component floats above a surface.
Depth.behavior: Layering clarifies context without persistent workspace behavior.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System motion for state and layer transitions.
Momentum.behavior: Changes feel responsive and respect reduced motion.

State.decision: Use explicit state precedence from the contract.
State.example: disabled > warning > open > focus > hover > closed

Tone.decision: Use warning or critical tone only with visible reason.
Tone.behavior: Risk is explained through copy and state.

Growth.decision: Escalate orchestration beyond one local control to patterns.

Symbol.decision: Use symbols as support for visible labels or accessible names.
Symbol.behavior: Icons accelerate recognition without replacing meaning.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizing and optical alignment.
Iconography.behavior: Symbols align with text and target size.

Accessibility.decision: Expose label, state, focus, keyboard, and dismissal or selection behavior.
Accessibility.behavior: Assistive technology can operate the component.

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Allows the trigger to align to a form row while keeping the panel contextual.

props.name: disabled
props.notes: Disables the trigger and panel opening.

props.name: actions
props.type: Array<{ label: string, variant?: string, key?: string }>
props.notes: Optional local actions rendered with Button.

props.name: field
props.type: { label?: string, value?: string, placeholder?: string, helper?: string }
props.notes: Optional one-field local edit rendered with Input.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.notes: Called when local open state changes.

props.name: onAction
props.notes: Called when a local action is selected.

do: Use when Tooltip is too small for the content.
Anchor the panel to a visible trigger.
Keep content short and locally actionable.
dont: Do not place long forms or processs inside Popover.
Do not use Popover as persistent detail panel.
Do not hide required instructions behind an optional trigger.
info: Check mobile escalation when space is tight.

agentInstructions: Use Popover for short contextual panels, local actions, metric explanations, and small anchored forms.
Escalate to Bottom Sheet on mobile when content needs more space.
Keep trigger, panel label, and dismissal rules explicit.
rejectIf: Panel is detached from its trigger.
Required content is hidden without fallback.
